test_training: test a diffusers model by running a forward pass and computing MSE loss with backward pass
test_training_with_ema: test a diffusers model training loop with an EMA model step after the backward pass
test_gradient_checkpointing: test that a diffusers model supports enabling and disabling gradient checkpointing at runtime
test_gradient_checkpointing_is_applied: test that gradient checkpointing is applied to all expected submodules after enabling it on the model
test_gradient_checkpointing_equivalence: test that gradient checkpointing produces equivalent loss and parameter gradients compared to a non-checkpointed model
